common.what_is_measured: ILO task exposure and OECD research indices; WEF global survey expectations; selected Malaysian occupational evidence
common.what_is_not_measured: Malaysia-specific adoption speed by role or skill, individual displacement probabilities, realised salary changes, and validated future skill importance multipliers
common.scenario_label: Team-defined what-if sensitivity simulation, not empirical workforce forecast
common.trend_label: Only display an external signal as observed when its exact observation unit and geography are specified; global employer expectations are survey observations, not measured Malaysian hiring
common.score_label: Readiness measures overlap with a selected skill catalogue under explicit modelling weights; it is not an employment likelihood

frontend_disclosure_rules: Never describe OECD index, ILO gradient, or career readiness as probability of losing a job.
Do not aggregate OECD and ILO into a single unsupported risk score.
Show source date and geography alongside WEF global employer expectations.
Show scenario assumption version and separate active trend snapshot ID.
Show neutral/nonchanging scores honestly for users with all or no matched skills.
Do not claim that all six careers have directly measured Malaysian skill-level trends.
